review.method: One bounded inline correctness and criteria review, with implicated scope/type fixes verified by focused tests. No delegated, independent or cross-model reviewers.

verification.developmentRuns: Corrected a redundant array spread, a stale Svelte coverage-table case name, stale generated examples, and an exact 2-byte keyed gzip shift. The full native suite exposed an agent-carried Node root-name restriction that conflicted with the proposal’s lexical-shadowing rule; removed it in both implementations. Kept original guard true/false assertions using a surrounding template. New shadowing probes exposed inherited index/dimension types and filter-scope errors, fixed in the owning type/runtime/target layers. All final gates pass.
verification.other: Lint, TypeScript, generated examples, runtime capability/size gates, all package builds and five complete Fluid/native output validations pass. No behavioral assertion or coverage list was reduced.

size.scope: All fifteen compiled fixture ceilings and complete-live capability inventory pass. The keyed fixture remains 20798 raw bytes; minifier allocation shifts gzip from 8326 to 8328 B under Node 24, recorded as an exact ceiling with no extra allowance. The final complete live bundle falls from 93231 to 93155 B gzip.

verifiedBehavior.bindings: Only the named item and optional zero-based index alias. Aliases may shadow outer names; the item and index within one iteration must differ. Ordinary declared loop/index bindings remain valid. Item/index types belong to their lexical layer, including numeric aliases shadowing dimensional outer values.
verifiedBehavior.listSize: Existing .length on the referenced list; iteration shaping does not change that list.
verifiedBehavior.presentation: CSS structural selectors on rendered children.
verifiedBehavior.shaping: Where reads the candidate item plus outer bindings; limit reads the enclosing scope; key and body read the shaped row index.
